summary: ChipMOS TECHNOLOGIES INC. filed a Form 6-K reporting board resolutions from its May 12, 2026 board meeting. The sole substantive matter was the approval of the company's consolidated financial statements for Q1 2026. The filing discloses operating revenue of NT$6,935,628 thousand, basic EPS of NT$0.72, and total assets of NT$44,831,224 thousand. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, capital returns, or management changes. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a standard 8-K earnings release in the US. No action or watch item is warranted.
